domestic_evidence: No domestic-supply record could be retrieved. thecompanycheck.com, zaubacorp.com, trademo.com and eximpedia.app all returned HTTP 403 Forbidden; DuckDuckGo search backend was unreachable ('searx: <urlopen error [Errno 111] Connection refused>'), so no GeM/CPPP tender, GST turnover band or annual-report split could be located. GST turnover: null (not public in retrieved sources).
note: Export side is factually confirmed, not merely declared: four dated India-origin customs records with named foreign consignees, HS codes and bill-of-lading numbers (9300186, 9253986, 9125453, 9041385), latest 2026-02-02, destinations USA, Malaysia, Singapore, plus a South African buyer lane. Declared HS 841360 matches the observed export HS codes 84136010 and 84136020 (screw/gear positive-displacement pumps) — no HS correction needed; note that one observed row is HS 84139190 (pump parts), which is a normal accessory line, not a mismatch. The company also imports heavily (e.g. from Settima Meccanica S.r.l., Italy, HS 84136090, BOL 7348091, 2026-02-06), i.e. it is a pump maker/trader with two-way trade. Source counter caveat: ImportKey advertises 765 total shipments but the free view exposes only 5 rows, so the 765 figure is the portal's claim, not a count I verified. Domestic (India) supply activity is unverified — not 'none found', simply not retrievable with the tools available; GST turnover and revenue left null rather than estimated. No rejection grounds: entity is active and trading.
